reconcile.note: John Gill surveys three fixes for Jacob and Eli: one man with two names, a legal versus natural father, or Luke tracing Jesus's line through Mary.

discrepancy.note: Strauss names the immediate clash: Matthew calls Joseph's father Jacob while Luke calls him Heli, a difference he treats as a genuine contradiction.

quotes.text: In Matthew, the father of Joseph is called Jacob; in Luke, Heli.…Since this difference appears to offer a complete contradiction, the most industrious efforts have been made at all times to reconcile the two.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined (1846), ch. on the genealogies, on Matthew 1:16 and Luke 3:23.

sides.snippet: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary
sides.verseText: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

sides.snippet: being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli
sides.verseText: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
